name: Sakura Memories
source:
You're an ordinary college student. But coincidentally, you come across a chance to work on a class project with a classmate. Will you be able to successively go on a date with her?

[From [url=https://eric-ex.itch.io/sakuramemories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个普通的大学生。但巧合的是，你有机会与同学一起完成课堂项目。你能顺利地和她约会吗？

[来自[url=https://eric-ex.itch.io/sakuramemories]Itch.io[/url]]
